dedupe_keys.name: aiddata china s official seaport finance dataset 2000 2021

description: AidData's China's Official Seaport Finance Dataset tracks 123 seaport projects officially financed by China to build or expand 78 ports in 46 low- and middle-income countries. Thirteen Chinese lenders and donors provided 29.9 billion US dollars in loans and grants for these projects between 2000 and 2021, implemented between 2000 and 2023 by 30 Chinese and 42 non-Chinese companies. Each port has detailed records of financial terms and conditions and project implementation, GeoJSON boundaries of the port, latitude and longitude, and a precision marker saying whether the location is precise or approximate. Coverage is global across the recipient countries. It was published on 25 July 2023 and is free to download as a zip file from AidData, with a recommended citation; a copy is also served as an ArcGIS feature service. The licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: ports funded purely by private Chinese foreign direct investment are excluded, while state-owned or majority state-owned entities are included, and some locations are approximate. The data inform capacity planning and investment scenarios for port networks and exposure studies of financed port assets; AidData also used them in its report on China's ports footprint. It complements the African development corridors database.
